kurzfassung: The creators of The Dossier join the podcast to analyze the ongoing trial surrounding Tupac Shakur's death and expose major flaws in the official narrative. They discuss the suspicious lack of key law enforcement witnesses and argue that the original investigations were compromised. Furthermore, the guests break down the long-standing police cover-ups and the hidden files connected to the murder of Biggie Smalls.
stichpunkte: Guests predict a hung jury in the Keefe D trial due to shaky confessions and a lack of credible law enforcement testimony.
Investigators point out blatant factual errors in Keefe D's statements, including impossible timelines and locations.
The panel highlights that lead investigator Greg Kading was never called to testify under oath because of his compromised disciplinary record.
The conversation shifts to the Biggie Smalls murder, emphasizing that Puffy was likely the intended target.
Panelists detail how LAPD hid hundreds of pages of documents linking corrupt officers David Mack and Rafael Perez to the crime.
The guests stress that their findings rely strictly on unredacted law enforcement files and the work of respected detectives like Russell Poole and Phil Carson.
Valetta Wallace never supported Greg Kading's theory and always backed the thorough investigations conducted by Russ Poole.

clips.hook: Turning a murder trial into a reality TV show
clips.text: The defense successfully highlighted that authorities never bothered to verify the claims made in the confession, relying instead on YouTube creators and documentary producers as star witnesses.

clips.hook: Thirteen shots miss the heavy target entirely
clips.text: During the shooting, a heavy-set passenger emerged completely uninjured from a barrage of thirteen bullets, whereas a lighter passenger seated nearby was struck multiple times.

clips.hook: The highest honors in law enforcement
clips.text: One of the lead investigators received the Attorney General's Award of Excellence directly from top federal directors in recognition of his thorough corruption probe.
Federal judges had to deploy U.S. Marshals to raid a prestigious police division and uncover a hidden drawer where crucial evidence implicating specific officers had been concealed.

clips.hook: A massive horse and pony show for taxpayers
clips.text: Law enforcement executed a dramatic, heavily armed raid on a suspect's home without solid evidence, creating an expensive spectacle that ultimately led nowhere.

beschreibung:
On this episode we finally get to sit down with Nikki, Johnny The Greek and Don Socorski from “The Dossier” podcast. We dive right into the Keefe D trial and why this whole thing was a bunch of BS, Sean Combs work with the Feds, how the corrupt LAPD was out here performing hits and a whole bunch of other revelations get brought to light.
